class OuterAccess {
  private x=1;
  protected y=2;
  make() { return new class { get(a:OuterAccess) { return a.x+a.y; } }; }
}
const outerAccess = new OuterAccess();
console.log(outerAccess.make().get(outerAccess));
class AccessBase { protected value=3; }
class AccessDerived extends AccessBase {
  make() { return new class { get(a:AccessDerived) { return a.value; } }; }
}
const derivedAccess = new AccessDerived();
console.log(derivedAccess.make().get(derivedAccess));
